quizzes.stem: A team runs a nightly job that tags 50,000 short support tickets with one of eight labels. Latency does not matter, cost does, and the tags are simple. Which first step is best?

options.a: Start with the fastest, lowest-cost tier and evaluate on real samples
options.b: Start with the top tier for the best accuracy on every ticket
options.c: Split the tickets across all four tiers at random
options.d: Fine-tune a model on past tickets before any testing

explanation.a: Simple, high-volume, cost-sensitive work fits the efficiency-first path, validated on real data (the two strategies).
explanation.b: Ruled out because the page lists accuracy-over-cost scenarios for the capability-first path, and this one is the opposite.
explanation.c: Ruled out because a random split matches no task to any tier, which the worked decision rules out.
explanation.d: Ruled out because the glossary says the Claude API does not offer fine-tuning at present, and anything chosen before testing skips the evaluation step.

quizzes.stem: A coding agent on the mid-priced tier fails a handful of hard tasks per day. The team plans to move the whole system to the top tier. What should they try first?

options.a: Remove the system prompt to save tokens
options.c: Raise the effort setting for just those cases
options.d: Switch to the model with the newest retirement date

explanation.c: The page says tuning effort is often a better lever than switching models, and a narrower change targets the hard tasks only.
explanation.b: Ruled out because a lower output cap would truncate answers without adding capability.
explanation.a: Ruled out because removing instructions cuts guidance, not cost-effectively improves hard tasks.
explanation.d: Ruled out because a retirement date is a lifecycle fact and says nothing about capability.

quizzes.stem: A marketing manager with no engineering support wants Claude to draft weekly newsletters in the house style, using last quarter's issues as reference. Which approach fits best?

options.a: Build a service that calls the Messages API weekly
options.c: Run an Agent SDK program on a scheduled server
options.d: Create an app Project holding the guidelines and earlier editions

explanation.d: A Project holds instructions and reference files for recurring non-developer work (the apps bullet).
explanation.a: Ruled out because the map says building application code buys nothing here.
explanation.c: Ruled out because an agent on a server is infrastructure for a task a Project does without code.
explanation.b: Ruled out because cloud platforms address account and traffic control, which the scenario does not mention.

quizzes.stem: A bank requires that all model traffic stay inside its existing infrastructure account, under its own identity rules, while developers keep using the same models. Which surface fits?

options.a: The consumer apps on personal accounts
options.b: Calling them through the company's cloud provider
options.c: A managed agent in Anthropic's sandbox
options.d: The terminal tool on each laptop

explanation.b: The cloud platforms row is the one that keeps traffic in the customer's cloud account and identity model.
explanation.a: Ruled out because personal consumer accounts are outside the bank's control.
explanation.c: Ruled out because managed agents run in Anthropic-managed or self-hosted sandboxes, and the page says they are not eligible for zero data retention.
explanation.d: Ruled out because a developer tool on each laptop answers how developers work, not where the traffic and identity rules sit.

quizzes.stem: A developer says: "I told Claude in our shared workspace to answer in French, so my API integration will too." What is wrong with this expectation?

options.a: French is unsupported on the API
options.b: Instructions stay hidden until a tier upgrade
options.c: The API ignores any language requests
options.d: Those instructions are read only inside the chat product

explanation.d: Where instructions live decides where they are read (the carry-across section).
explanation.a: Ruled out because nothing on the pages restricts languages on the API.
explanation.c: Ruled out because the API follows instructions in the request and system prompt.
explanation.b: Ruled out because tiers do not gate where an instruction is read.

quizzes.stem: A support team writes thousands of short, similar replies each hour and occasionally meets a delicate complaint. Which plan balances cost and quality?

options.a: Route routine drafts to a fast tier and rare complaints to a stronger one
options.b: Send every draft to the strongest tier for uniform quality
options.c: Send every draft to the fastest tier to protect the budget
options.d: Alternate tiers by time of day to even out the load

explanation.a: Matching the model to the task in both directions, with an evaluation set, is the worked decision.
explanation.b: Ruled out because it wastes cost and latency on routine work.
explanation.c: Ruled out because it under-serves the complaints that need depth.
explanation.d: Ruled out because time of day matches no task to a tier.

quizzes.stem: A new feature must call a specific Claude model for the next two years. A reviewer flags the model id in the code. What is the most likely concern?

options.a: The model's retirement date may arrive before the product's end
options.b: Dated ids cannot be used with the API
options.c: Ids must be changed with every request
options.d: Alias names raise the price per token

explanation.a: The table shows retirement dates, and a model with a near date needs a migration plan.
explanation.b: Ruled out because the table gives a dated id for Haiku 4.5.
explanation.c: Ruled out because a pinned id is meant to stay fixed.
explanation.d: Ruled out because the pages say nothing about alias pricing.

quizzes.stem: A solo developer wants help refactoring a repository from the terminal. Which surface fits?

options.a: A Project in the chat app
options.b: A bespoke integration on the Messages API

explanation.c: Claude Code is the agentic coding tool for a repository.
explanation.a: Ruled out because a chat Project has no repository access.
explanation.b: Ruled out because it means building the tool the product already provides.
explanation.d: Ruled out because a managed agent suits long-running asynchronous work in managed infrastructure, not a developer's interactive refactor.

quizzes.stem: A team pins `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` in production and plans nothing else. Which statement is true, from the model table?

options.a: The id will track new releases automatically
options.b: The id is a pinned snapshot with a published retirement window
options.c: The id is valid only on cloud platforms
options.d: The id has a larger window than the top tier

explanation.b: The page states every id is a pinned snapshot and lists a retirement date for it.
explanation.a: Ruled out because a snapshot does not move.
explanation.c: Ruled out because the same id works on the Claude API, as the table shows.
explanation.d: Ruled out because the 200K window is the smallest in the table.
